theorems.name: Submission.variation_sqrt_derivatives_at_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (h₁ : ℝ), h 0 = 1 → HasDerivAt h h₁ 0 → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ Real.sqrt (h t)) (h₁ / 2) 0 ∧ ∀ h₂ : ℝ, (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, DifferentiableAt ℝ h t) → HasDerivAt (deriv h) h₂ 0 → HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t ↦ Real.sqrt (h t))) (h₂ / 2 - h₁ ^ 2 / 4) 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
